mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_title, agent_id, model_id, status, last_message_at, message_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, deduct_tokens, conversation_id FROM chat_session WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET agent_id = #{agentId}, model_id = #{modelId}, message_count = message_count + 1, last_message_at = #{updateTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE chat_session SET model_id = #{modelId}, message_count = message_count + 1, input_tokens = input_tokens + #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = output_tokens + #{outputTokens}, deduct_tokens = deduct_tokens + #{deductTokens}, last_message_at = #{updateTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
